t: From Cursor to Command Line: Embracing Gemini CLI for a Future-Proof Workflow
s: A developer transitions from GUI AI-enhanced editors like Cursor to the command-line Gemini CLI, prioritizing FOSS, discipline, and a future-proof workflow over GUI bloat and vendor lock-in, despite initial NixOS installation challenges.
sub: Transitioning from GUI AI editors (Cursor) to CLI AI (Gemini CLI)
NixOS installation challenges and Nix flake best practices
Philosophical shift: CLI discipline vs. GUI bloat
Comparison of agentic AI CLI tools and FOSS licensing
VSCode fork 'forking war' and Microsoft's competitive response
